scope: Five public links in the Recently added funding for your studies in Denmark section. The full catalogue requires registration. Five separately listed outbound-study links were excluded.

records.title: Thisted Kommune education grant
records.summary: One-off education grant awarded in October. Applicants need a connection to Thisted Municipality; applications are accepted online from 1 to 30 September each year through a Danish digital identity service.
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality not addressed; connection to Thisted Municipality is required
records.country_basis: Danish municipal education grant; the location of study is not stated

records.title: Nordfyns Kommunes Faelleslegat for vaerdigt traengende
records.summary: Municipal hardship fund that also supports young students from Nordfyns Municipality. Applicants must reside in the municipality and demonstrate financial need; the application period runs from week 41 to week 44.
records.amount_detail: Listing shows approximately EUR 134; individual award not confirmed
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality not addressed; residence in Nordfyns Municipality and financial need required
records.country_basis: Local Danish municipal hardship fund; destination of study is not specified

records.title: Viborg Stift - Provst Hans Christian Erichsen og hustru Ella Margrethe født Utzons Legat
records.summary: One-off theology study grant. The listed conditions require financial need and a father who is or was a priest in the Danish national church; the source says only men can apply.
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality not addressed; strict family, gender and financial-need conditions apply
records.country_basis: Danish diocesan fund; the study destination is not explicitly stated

records.title: University of Copenhagen - Relief Fund for Pharmaceutical Sciences students
records.summary: One-off support for PharmaSchool bachelor's or master's students and recent graduates facing acute financial hardship, or for a thesis research stay abroad of at least one month. PhD students cannot apply.
records.amount_detail: Up to DKK 20,000 (approximately EUR 2,680) per application
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality not addressed; prior PharmaSchool study or graduation required
records.country_basis: Support is tied to the University of Copenhagen; one grant category funds thesis research abroad

records.title: H.C. Andersens Fond study grant (Studielegat)
records.summary: One-off grant towards education in Denmark for a young person living in Odense who is already studying or plans to start. No fixed application deadline or award amount is stated.
records.study_level: Young people in or about to start education
records.brazil_criteria: Brazilian nationality not addressed; residence in Odense required
records.country_basis: The grant supports education in Denmark but requires residence in Odense
